tools.name: check_tool
tools.description: Live status and 30-day reliability of a public remote MCP server, from independent hourly probes. Pass the registry name (e.g. "com.example/server"), the endpoint URL or host, or the short server name. Returns status (up, auth required, degraded, down, error, blocked), latency, tool count, schema ha

tools.name: standings
tools.description: The latest daily standings of tracked MCP servers, ranked by 7-day uptime then p95 latency.
